PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Unveils New Offshore Equipment in UAE Market

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, a leading provider in the Oil & Gas Services & Equip sector, has announced the launch of its new offshore engineering equipment line in the United Arab Emirates, aiming to strengthen its position in the region’s rapidly expanding energy services market.

The company unveiled the new suite of equipment at a ceremony in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, attended by industry representatives and local officials. The product line includes advanced subsea tools, remote-operated vehicles, and digital monitoring systems, designed to support the UAE’s ongoing offshore exploration and production projects.

Nguyen Van Minh, Regional Director for PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, stated, “Our latest technologies reflect our commitment to supporting the UAE’s vision for energy innovation and operational excellence. We are confident that our solutions will deliver value to local operators as they expand production capacity in a competitive global market.”

According to the UAE’s Ministry of Energy, the country’s offshore oil and gas sector has seen a 10% increase in capital expenditure over the past year, fueling demand for high-specification technical services and equipment. “The arrival of new players and products enhances the market’s resilience and technology adoption,” said Fatima Al Mansouri, an analyst at Gulf Energy Insights.

Industry observers note that the launch is well-timed, as several offshore projects near Abu Dhabi and Sharjah are ramping up development. Local engineering contractor Zayed Marine Services has expressed interest in evaluating the new equipment for upcoming projects.

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp plans to provide training and after-sales support to UAE clients as part of its regional expansion strategy.
